meta.note: Synthetic data. The company, brands, people and every sales figure are invented.

insights.text: To close November 2026 on target, daily sales must run +6% versus the pace so far (BDT 3.5 crore a day against BDT 3.3 crore).
Dhaka Metro is projected at 94% of target, the weakest region; North leads at 99%.
Kesh is the fastest-growing brand this year, +20% on last year; Jhakjhak is the slowest at +5%.
Unfilled orders cost BDT 3.5 crore on Kesh 180ml this year, the most of any SKU (fill rate 89%).
23% of primary sales in October 2026 were invoiced in the last three working days: stock is being loaded to close the month.
306 of 631 SRs hit their October 2026 target; incentives paid BDT 30.8 lakh.
